zh: 中位数是组内第二大的数，所以想要高中位数，组里需要一个更大的数和中位数本身，第三个数越小越好。
若组成 q 组，第 j 大的中位数至多是全局第 2j 大的值；把最大的 2q 个数相邻两两配对、再各配一个较小的数，能同时达到所有上界。值都为正，所以 q 取 floor(n/3)。
升序排序；答案 = 对 i=0..floor(n/3)−1 求 a[n−2−2i] 之和，用 64 位整数。
en: The median is the second largest member of a group, so a high median needs one larger value plus the median itself, and the third member should be as small as possible.

With q groups, the j-th largest median is at most the 2j-th largest value overall; pairing the largest 2q values two by two and adding one small value to each pair attains all bounds at once. Values are positive, so take q = floor(n/3).
Sort ascending; the answer is the sum of a[n-2-2i] for i = 0..floor(n/3)-1, using 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After sorting, form at most floor(n/3) groups: repeatedly take two servers from the largest end, the smaller of which contributes the median, and give the group one of the smallest remaining servers.

## Proof of correctness

When q groups are formed, list the group medians in descending order; the j-th median needs at least 2j servers not smaller than it, so its upper bound is the 2j-th largest value overall. Pairing the largest 2q servers with their neighbours and adding q smaller servers attains all of these bounds at once. All values are positive, so a larger q gives a larger sum of bounds, hence take floor(n/3).

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n), with a 64-bit answer.
